mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may increase raloxifene's thrombotic risk; raloxifene may reduce renal potassium excretion through estrogenic effects on sodium-potassium balance.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing diuretic or supplementation; assess thromboembolic risk periodically.
